Render an OMOP-ES extract summary report

Source: R/extract-summary-report.R
extract_summary_report.Rd

Generates and renders an HTML summary report documenting OMOP-ES plugin metadata using a bundled R Markdown template.

Usage

extract_summary_report(
  conn,
  schema_public = "dbo",
  omop_es_path,
  settings_id = "CUH_EPIC_small_cohort",
  cohort_limit = 10,
  output_dir = getwd(),
  plugin_metadata = omop_es_plugins_extract_metadata(omop_es_path = omop_es_path,
    settings_id = settings_id, cohort_limit = cohort_limit),
  view = TRUE
)

Arguments

conn, schema_public

Currently unused. The report is built entirely from plugin_metadata, and omop_es_plugins_extract_metadata() opens its own connections in a subprocess, so no connection is needed here.

omop_es_path

Path to the OMOP-ES repository directory.

settings_id

Identifier for the OMOP-ES settings configuration to use. Defaults to "CUH_EPIC_small_cohort".

cohort_limit

Maximum patient cohort size used during metadata extraction. Defaults to 10.

output_dir

Directory path where the output HTML report will be saved. Defaults to the active working directory via getwd().

plugin_metadata

Named list containing plugin metadata. Defaults to automatically calling omop_es_plugins_extract_metadata().

view

Logical; if TRUE, opens the compiled HTML report in the RStudio Viewer pane using rstudioapi::viewer(). Defaults to TRUE.

Value

Called for its side effect of writing the report to extract_summary_report.html in output_dir. The path returned by rmarkdown::render() is discarded rather than passed on, so do not rely on the return value.

Details

The function fetches or accepts plugin metadata via omop_es_plugins_extract_metadata(), restructures it with purrr::list_transpose(), and passes it as parameters to the bundled omop_es_extract_summary.Rmd template via rmarkdown::render(). The resulting HTML report is saved to output_dir and can optionally be previewed directly in the RStudio Viewer pane.
